# Country scope = the leader of the Middle Kingdom. The tab shows for the Yuan while it has a branch secretariat or a prince.
oe_yuan_ui_tab = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = { tag = CHI is_rebel_country = no any_subject = { OR = { OR = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier tag = LNG tag = KOR } oe_yw_prince_active = yes } } }
}
# Country scope = a subject of the leader. v14.5: includes Yunnan (LNG) and Zhengdong (KOR) alongside the 9 oe_yp secretariats.
oe_yuan_ui_prov = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = { country_exists = c:CHI is_subject_of = c:CHI OR = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier tag = LNG tag = KOR } }
}
oe_yuan_ui_prince = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes }
}
# Country scope = the player. The grant level (gen_yuan_y5b.py oe_yw_set_grant_level): only the Yuan itself may set it.
oe_yuan_ui_grant_0 = {
    scope = country
    is_valid = { tag = CHI is_rebel_country = no has_global_variable = oe_yw_on NOT = { var:oe_yw_grant_level ?= 0 } }
    effect = { oe_yw_set_grant_level = { level = 0 } }
}

# v14.5 Princes 2.0: 3 per-prince interactive buttons (CMDLOG=0, O(1), AddScope target_country).
oe_yw_gui_bestow_seal = {
    scope = country
    saved_scopes = { target_country }
    is_valid = {
        tag = CHI
        is_rebel_country = no
        gold >= 35
        scope:target_country = {
            oe_yw_prince_active = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_cd_seal }
        }
    }
    effect = { oe_yw_gui_bestow_seal_effect = yes }
}
oe_yw_gui_summon_banner = {
    scope = country
    saved_scopes = { target_country }
    is_valid = {
        tag = CHI
        is_rebel_country = no
        gold >= 40
        scope:target_country = {
            oe_yw_prince_active = yes
            has_variable = oe_yw_loy
            var:oe_yw_loy >= 65
            manpower >= 0.8
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_cd_banner }
        }
    }
    effect = { oe_yw_gui_summon_banner_effect = yes }
}
oe_yw_gui_commute_prov = {
    scope = country
    saved_scopes = { target_country }
    is_valid = {
        tag = CHI
        is_rebel_country = no
        OR = {
            is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_yuan_restoration
            has_global_variable = oe_sit2_yr_ended
            current_year >= 1400
        }
        scope:target_country = {
            oe_yw_prince_active = yes
            has_variable = oe_yw_loy
            var:oe_yw_loy >= 75
        }
    }
    effect = { oe_yw_gui_commute_prov_effect = yes }
}
